title: E-commerce iOS app in SwiftUI — browse, cart, checkout
footer: Ajay Girolkar · Senior iOS Engineer · 11 yrs · Global banks & fintech
hero_sub: Browse, product detail, cart, checkout. Production SwiftUI wired to Shopify, WooCommerce, or your own API — built by an engineer with 11 years of payments work.
grid_title: Six screens from a build like yours
deliverables: Catalog, search, filters, and product detail
Cart and checkout flow with Apple Pay ready
Shopify, WooCommerce or custom REST wired up
Image caching so the grid scrolls at 120fps
Empty, loading and error states designed, not skipped
Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels
Loom walkthrough of the code and how to extend it

process.title: Requirements
process.body: You send designs, your commerce backend and API keys. Delivery clock starts here.

process.title: Foundation
process.body: Design tokens, navigation and the product model land. You get a build to run.

process.title: Storefront
process.body: Catalog, detail, cart and checkout built against your live data. Daily push to your repo.

process.title: Ship
process.body: Code walkthrough, revision round, and a checklist for App Store submission.

fit_title: Is this the right project for you?
fit_good: You already sell online and want a native iPhone app
You have designs, a Figma file, or a reference app
Your catalog is on Shopify, WooCommerce or a REST API
You want native SwiftUI, not a web view wrapper
fit_bad: You need the store backend built from scratch
You want an Android app in the same order
You need a custom payment gateway certified
The scope is open-ended or still being decided
